== History ==
[[E:rfurt A:llS:tars T:eam]] was formed by players from the clans [[Syndicate Quake Clan]] and [[Pentagon]], all coming from the small east-german town Erfurt. Even if they never made it to any importance in competitive play, they are still a bunch of good buddies.
